data.G: Pending research: no optimized candidate or independent confirmation is available yet. Integrate only measured, correct candidates, then confirm the final choice on the separate-seed protocol.
data.analysis: I choose N=2: the baseline is valid but takes a mean 5.710953335 s at n=1024, and its serial row/column/K loops have no OpenMP use. Two complementary routes merit concurrent research: loop interchange, cache tiling, and OpenMP with compiler-vectorized contiguous columns; and a distinct packed-panel, register-tiled SIMD kernel. Keeping the first route unpacked and free of explicit intrinsics limits duplication. The supplied target is AMD EPYC 9654 with GCC 14.2; the available target metadata says x86_64, but effective build flags were not provided. GCC 14.2 documentation lists AVX-512 and FMA support for znver4, so the SIMD tree should verify compatibility with the frozen build rather than assume a compiler flag. Both trees must preserve the fixed FP64 tolerance and full-output overwrite, handle supported sizes and the thread budget, and report failed attempts. Only the baseline has been measured; candidates require correctness validation and comparable timing, and final G requires independent confirmation. Two focused trees leave time for integration and confirmation within the supplied remaining duration.

children.objective: In src/candidate.cpp, explore an unpacked GEMM route based on loop interchange (including i-k-j), cache tiling, and OpenMP ownership of disjoint output rows or tiles. Keep the output-column loop contiguous so the frozen GCC build can auto-vectorize it; do not pack matrices or use explicit x86 intrinsics, keeping this route distinct from the SIMD tree. Tune loop/tile order and scheduling using measured performance, including whether to avoid parallel overhead on small sizes. Respect threads (at most eight), read-only inputs, and complete output overwrite on every call. Preserve correctness for all supported sizes and signed, varying inputs within abs_error <= 0.002 + 5e-5*abs(reference). Change only src/candidate.cpp; record failed attempts and compare valid repeated native timings, prioritizing n=1024.
children.subject: Unpacked cache-tiled loop ordering with OpenMP and compiler vectorization

children.objective: In src/candidate.cpp, explore a separate packed-panel GEMM using a register-tiled FP32 FMA/SIMD microkernel and OpenMP over disjoint output tiles. Investigate panel layout, microkernel shape, and packing/tile choices; test AVX-512 or AVX2 only when compatible with the frozen GCC build and target, without changing compiler settings. Include packing and scratch allocation in the measured runtime, handle tails and small sizes without specializing to test values, and provide a safe compatible path if needed. Respect threads (at most eight), overwrite all output each invocation, and validate varying signed inputs against the fixed FP64 tolerance. Change only src/candidate.cpp; record failed attempts and report correctness and repeated native timings, prioritizing n=1024.
children.subject: Packed-panel SIMD/FMA register-tiled GEMM
